theorems.name: Submission.allard52_gpa_isometry_conj
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ), (∀ K : Submodule ℝ (Amb n ℓ), (K.map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap).starProjection = q.toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap ∘L K.starProjection ∘L q.symm.toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap) ∧ ∀ X : Amb n ℓ →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ, hsNormSq (q.toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap ∘L X ∘L q.symm.toLinearIsometry.toContinuousLinearMap) = hsNormSq X
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
